name: The Case of the Serialized Killer
source:
When a popular illustrator is found dead, disgraced demonologist Harold Ludicael is hired to summon her ghost. Ghosts are the one thing he can't summon, but with sharp insight, perhaps he can solve the mystery, and resurrect the most important thing:

His career.

[From [url=https://alexisroyce.itch.io/murder-mystery]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一位受欢迎的插画家被发现死亡，名誉扫地的恶魔学家哈罗德·卢迪卡尔受雇召唤她的鬼魂。鬼魂是他无法召唤的东西，但凭借敏锐的洞察力，也许他可以解开谜团，并复活最重要的东西：

他的职业生涯。

[来自[url=https://alexisroyce.itch.io/murder-mystery]itch.io[/url]]
